Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
很久以前，有一个老男人叫神农。神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服，所以他决定开始找新的药。他下一天开始爬当地的山脉，找了各种各样的植物。神农试一试每个植物，知道有什么好处。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 有一个老男人叫神农：老人，“老男人“ has negative meaning
- 神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服：delete “在古代”, it implies that 神农can travel between 古代 and 现代modern times; 都看到，no了for routine/habit; 别的小镇上的人；生病或者不舒服
- 他下一天开始爬当地的山脉：第二天，当地的大山，山脉is for geography

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个老男人叫神农：一个叫神农的老人，A name phrase needs to modify the noun with 的; 老人 is the usual neutral noun for an elderly man in this story. [rule: attributive_modifier_de]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的小镇人：小镇上的人，别的 is used to distinguish other people or things from a stated one, but no comparison group appears here; the corrected phrase clearly names the town’s residents. [teacher rule: bieren]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 生病还是不舒服：生病或感到不舒服，还是 is normally used to present alternatives in a question; an affirmative statement listing two possibilities uses 或. [rule: word_choice]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 下一天：第二天，第二天 is the standard narrative expression for the day after the event just described. [rule: time_expression]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 找了各种各样的植物：找到了各种各样的植物，找 means “look for,” while 找到 states that he successfully found the plants. [vocab list]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 每个植物：每种植物，Plants are classified by type with 种 in this context, rather than the general measure word 个. [rule: none]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服：他在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服，After the name has appeared in the immediately preceding sentence and no other character competes with it, use a pronoun for close re-occurrence. [rule: redundancy_delete]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农试一试每个植物：他试一试每个植物，The same character was the subject in the preceding sentence, so a pronoun is more natural for close re-occurrence. [rule: redundancy_delete]
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每一天看到了：每天看到，每天 describes a routine, so the verb takes the zero aspect marker rather than completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “老男人” has an inappropriate negative connotation here, while “老人” is neutral.
“小镇人” needs 上的, but deleting 别 loses the intended meaning of people from other towns.
In this affirmative statement, 或者 rather than 还是 correctly links the two conditions.
第二天 is the appropriate narrative expression for the following day.
找了各种各样的植物 can correctly mean that he looked for various plants; 找到 is not required.
For kinds of plants in this context, 每种植物 is the appropriate measure-word phrase.
The close re-mention should use 他, but the corrected sentence still contains several other errors.
A close re-mention of the same subject should use 他, but 每个植物 remains problematic.
每天 describes a habitual event, so 看到 should not take perfective 了.
